role: Voice-only NPC via the room's landline. Worried-mother cadence — phone-only, warm, asks if you've eaten before asking about money. Never seen on screen.
voiceExamples: Did you eat? Don't lie to your mother.
Money is paper. An empty stomach is real.
Send a little to your sister this month. She won't ask. That's why I'm asking.
Don't borrow there. From anyone. Tell me first. Even at two in the morning.
I made pickle. It is on its way. Don't waste it.
